title: Install resolves a shared collection member against both ranges
summary: Re-installing a collection whose member another installed collection lists at a different range no longer refuses when one release satisfies both, such as ^1.2.0 and ^1.4.0. The request becomes the range both accept, the lock pins a release every holder accepts, and each holder's collection row follows a pin that moves. Ranges no release can satisfy together still refuse with IA-DIST-CONFLICT, naming the holders. A range the user named directly, in this or an earlier command, is never narrowed: the collection record keeps it under a new optional `named` key, and a collection listing another range refuses. `@inventarch/db/distribution` exports `commonRange`, the range two ranges both accept.
